title.narrative: South Asia Subregional Economic Cooperation Road Connectivity Project

description.narrative: ADB and the Government of Nepal are working together to improve some of the most important roads in the country to help people and freight move more easily, and to increase trade with neighboring countries. The South Asia Subregional Economic Cooperation Road Connectivity Project is building alternative routes between the districts of Sunsari and Saptari to create year-round passable conditions along the East-West Highway, especially across the Koshi River. This will include the repair of feeder roads that connect nearby villages to the highway, and improve people's access to government services and livelihood opportunities. The project, which is providing jobs for unskilled workers in the area, particularly women seeking employment, is upgrading 73 kilometers of bypass and border roads along the East-West Highway to two lanes, and improving 114 kilometers of another strategic roadway. The project is also providing training for people in the area to protect the environment and encourage tourism.

title.narrative: 31 Jul 2013 | News Release: https://www.adb.org/news/adb-help-ensure-year-round-travel-nepals-busiest-highway
Loan 3012: 100% of contracts awarded and 100% disbursed as of 20 Sep 2023

Progress Toward Outcome: Construction of all 7 contract packages (2 ICB and 5 NCB) have been completed as of 30 December 2020. One contract package (Nadaha Pakali road, 11 km) has defects notification period until 31 December 2021.
Some results are in the Audited Project Financial Statements | Jan 2023: https://www.adb.org/sites/default/files/project-documents/38350/38350-013-apfs-en_5.pdf
Some results are in the Combined Resettlement Plan and Indigenous Peoples Plans | Sep 2020: https://www.adb.org/sites/default/files/project-documents/38350/38350-013-remdp-en_2.pdf
Some results are in the Initial Environmental Examination | Apr 2017: https://www.adb.org/sites/default/files/project-documents/38350/38350-013-iee-05.pdf
Some results are in the Safeguards Due Diligence Reports | Dec 2012: https://www.adb.org/sites/default/files/project-documents//38350-013-nep-rpddr-01.pdf
Some results are in the Social Monitoring Reports | Mar 2022: https://www.adb.org/sites/default/files/project-documents/38350/38350-013-smr-en_14.pdf

Status of Implementation Progress: 1. Road Upgrading:
72.53 km of construction work in the East-West Highway road section completed on 27 March 2020.
114 km of hill road completed. One ICB package (Leguwakhat-Bhojpur road) completed on 30 October 2019. Four NCB packages completed (Manthali Ramachap MR01:mid Jan 2018; Halesi-Diktel (HD) HD01: Jan 2019; HD02: Nov 2019; and HD03: May 2019. The Nadaha - Pakali road (11km) was substantially completed in December 2020 and is under defects notification period.
One NCB package (Memchipul- Biratmod) was terminated in May 2016.
463,702 person days employment generated, including 373,102 person days for local disadvantaged groups and 90,600 days were for women.
Total number of unskilled labor was 1,741, of which 530 were women. 29.6% of local unskilled labor for road upgrading were provided by women.
1,361 (55.6%) of 2,360 total participants were women during STI and human trafficking awareness training program conducted in project affected communities.
1,435 (52.6%0 of 2,728 total participants were women during road safety awareness campaigns conducted in project affected communities.
Slope protection work completed with 54.5% women workers.
The project supported consulting services on preparatory works for new investment projects.
2.Improved Capacity of MPIT in road maintenance, asset management and GESI activities
GESI guidelines approved by Minister, MPIT on 16 August 2017.
Integrated road maintenance scheme developed under TA 8412 and implemented.
TA 8413: 89% disbursed as of 20 Sep 2023
Tenders and Contracts Awarded: https://www.adb.org/projects/38350-013/main#project-tenders
